articles.title: Buium accepts challenge of 'earning' long-term contract with Canucks
Luke Schenn, Paul Cotter Talk Leaning into Early-Season Road Trip as Team-Bonding Opportunity
Canes Embracing The Target On Their Backs As Defending Champs

away.summary: The Vancouver Canucks (2-2-0) begin a six-game road trip in Carolina after a 6-5 overtime win over Edmonton to open the season. Zeev Buium is expected to play on the top defensive pairing with Filip Hronek, averaging 21:40 of ice time. The team is focusing on building chemistry during the extended road trip, with veterans like Luke Schenn emphasizing off-ice bonding.

out.detail: Injured (shoulder), practicing in a yellow no-contact jersey after offseason surgery, initially expected to miss 4-6 months from end of June.

home.summary: The Carolina Hurricanes (1-1-1) are preparing to host Vancouver after a 3-2 overtime win over Philadelphia. They are projecting Brandon Bussi to start in net, with Pyotr Kochetkov as backup. The team has been successful on the power play (3 of 5 goals) and is embracing their role as defending Stanley Cup champions, expecting opponents to bring their best effort every night.
